name: Japanese Novel Book
comment: An optional ----fenced front-matter block (key: value metadata), then one relative .jpnov source path per line. Deliberately error-agnostic: backslashes, non-.jpnov paths, missing files, and unknown/duplicate metadata keys are the language server's diagnostics to report — the grammar must not second-guess them (any key: value line inside the fences is painted as metadata). Like the parser, the front-matter region opens on a fence that is the first non-blank line: either at the very start of the document (\A), or inside the leading-blank-lines rule. There is no semantic-token layer for book files, so nothing can repaint over this.

patterns.comment: Leading blank lines. Opens zero-width on a blank first line and closes at the first non-blank line, unless that line is a fence: the front matter then opens inside (applyEndPatternLast) and its closing fence, which leaves the line end unconsumed, closes this rule too, so a later `---` in the body cannot reopen it.

A cover list item `- path.jpnov` (full-width － tolerated like the parser). Error-agnostic: whether the item is orphaned, duplicated, or missing is the server's diagnostic; a non-.jpnov item goes unpainted exactly like a non-.jpnov chapter line. Must precede the key-value rule (a path may contain a colon).
